title: Recipe-kernel dispatch sites hand-roll shader module, set layout and pool
body: VulkanGraphApplication.cpp RecipeBucketedDispatch (~1128) and BucketShade (~1390) create the VkShaderModule raw, the set layout with BuildDescriptorSetLayoutFromReflection (node-owned, destroyed at teardown) and the descriptor pool raw; only the pipeline goes through ComputePipelineCacher. Because PipelineLayoutCacher keys by set-layout handle, a destroyed-and-reused layout handle can alias a stale pipeline layout. Move the module onto ShaderModuleCacher and the set layout onto DescriptorSetLayoutCacher (same shape as DescriptorSetNode in op-vixencachedefault). Tier luna: two sites, teardown ownership changes, needs a recipe-scene run.

title: PipelineLayoutCacher keys pipeline layouts by set-layout handle, not content
body: pipeline_layout_cacher.cpp ComputeKey hashes the VkDescriptorSetLayout handle (its own TODO). A caller that destroys its set layout and creates another can get the same handle value back and receive a pipeline layout built for the old layout. op-vixencachedefault moved DescriptorSetNode and ShellRevalidateNode onto DescriptorSetLayoutCacher so their handles are stable; content-keying the pipeline layout (set-layout bindings plus push ranges) removes the hazard for every caller. Tier luna: key change plus a test, touches every pipeline-layout user.

title: test_cache_codec deletes files it still has open (fails on Windows)
body: test_cache_codec.cpp opens std::ifstream in(path) (e.g. line 55) and calls std::filesystem::remove(path) (line 71) while it is still open; Windows refuses, so 9 CacheCodec tests and CacheEnvelope.ConcurrentWritersOnlyPublishCompletePayloads fail natively on the base and on op-vixencachedefault alike (unchanged since f9be032f). Close or scope the stream before each remove. Tier haiku: a test-only, one-pattern fix.

title: Warm launch still spends ~0.6 s in shader libraries after every SPIR-V hit
body: With all 12 SPIR-V compiles served from cache (op-vixencachedefault warm runs), the *_shader_lib nodes still total 0.52-0.68 s per launch: preprocessing (include file reads), SPIR-V reflection and SDI header generation run every time. Cache the reflection/SDI result keyed by the SPIR-V content hash in the shared store. Tier luna: measured cost, moderate change in ShaderBundleBuilder::PerformBuild.

title: Fresh build trees rebuild the voxel scene caches (~2.3 s first launch)
body: In the fresh-tree scenario (shared store populated, per-tree VIXEN cache empty) voxel_grid takes 1.37-1.54 s and body_octree_scene 0.75-1.0 s, against 0.05 s and ~0.6-0.8 s warm: VoxelSceneCacher and the body octree caches persist per build tree only. Content-keyed scene artifacts could live in Vixen::SharedDeviceCacheDirectory() like SPIR-V and pipeline blobs. Not a dispatch element, so out of op-vixencachedefault scope. Tier luna.

title: ShaderCompilationCacher has no production caller
body: CashSystem's ShaderCompilationCacher is only used by its tests; runtime SPIR-V caching is ShaderManagement's ShaderCacheManager (default for every ShaderCompiler compile since op-vixencachedefault). Delete it or fold it in. Tier haiku: dead-code removal with its tests.
